ns2:section.sectionText: This section will be taught online. Please see http://publish.illinois.edu/onlinestudentorientation/online-business-minor-courses/ for more information. This course will open to all students in the College of Business on Monday, April 17, 2017 and to the campus on Monday, April 24, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
